title: GET /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/objects/{name}/blocks: result
description: The addresses blocked on an object, as the object page's Blocked card shows them.

block_for.description: Value. How long a new block lasts, as the object writes it (such as 2h) or the engine's default.

count.description: Value. How many addresses the nodes hold blocked, listed or not.

addresses.description: The blocked addresses the nodes listed.

until.description: Value. When the longest of the nodes' blocks ends, from the reading's time.

seconds_left.description: Value. Seconds until until, at the time of the answer; 0 once passed.

ending.description: Value. True where the time ran out by the reading's account and no reading has said since.

nodes.description: Value. The nodes that hold the block.

reason.description: Value. Which limit placed the block or last renewed it (a later limit replaces manual): requests, errors or connections (the object's own limits), or manual for an address placed by hand or through the API; null where the node did not say, as for a block the earlier configuration placed.

truncated.description: Value. True where the nodes hold more addresses than they listed (at most a hundred each).

observed_at.description: Value. When the nodes were read; null where they never were.
